exact_missing_items: Gap: package-based worktrees are not yet defined as a canonical concept; per-node worktrees are the current model but are the wrong shape for scale
PM-owned SCM state is not fully visible: managed template repos, active git operations, live-run artifact roots, and worktree recovery state need Orchestrator/SCM registration
Worktree visibility is only partially wired between Source Control and Orchestrator — the interface contract between these two surfaces must be fully defined
Package-based lane pools are still missing as a canonical concept in SCM docs — WorktreeGitImprovement.md and GitHub_Integration.md must define this
Multi-account behavior exists in slices (provider/auth panels) but is not threaded through repo/project/worktree execution contracts — account identity must be end-to-end in all execution contracts
